nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Computer Applications Technology
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology — Grade 11 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 11 Term 1 covering Systems Technologies (general concepts, hardware, social implications, computer management), Solution Development (Word Processing, Spreadsheets, Database).

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: General Concepts
nodes.description: Information processing cycle (input, output, processing, storage and communication), types of computing devices and typical features, categorise computing devices, role of ICTs in the workplace.

assessmentStandards: Information processing cycle: Input, output, processing, storage and communication
Types of computing devices and typical features
The role of ICTs in the workplace

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Hardware
nodes.description: Extended hardware concepts from Grade 10: input (purpose, advantages, disadvantages, multi-touch screen), output (purpose, advantages, disadvantages), input and output devices for physically challenged users, 3D printers, HDMI, wearable devices and technologies, options available for enhancing accessibility.

assessmentStandards: Input: What is it, purpose, when to use, advantages, disadvantages and limitations
Output: What is it, purpose, when to use, advantages, disadvantages and limitations
Input and output devices for physically challenged users

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Hardware theft and protection, power settings, saving and protection against power failure, factors influencing health and health risks, value of CAT, career options and further study.

assessmentStandards: Hardware theft and protection, power settings, saving and protection against power failure
Factors influencing health and health risks
Value of CAT, career options and further study

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Computer Management
nodes.description: Primary storage (memory) vs secondary storage, online storage, Solid State Drive (SSD), memory card storage; processing: understanding the role of basic components of the system unit, overview and basic concepts of start-up process.

assessmentStandards: Understand the role of basic components of the system unit
Overview and basic concepts of start-up process

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: File management (input data from different file formats), editing (paste special, find and replace), printing, page layout (themes, document layout), paragraph (customise bullets and numbering, outline numbering, multi-level lists, customise spacing), templates (agenda, memo, basic resume, CV), electronic forms (legacy controls, Google forms, Microsoft forms), import and export data, online and offline help.

assessmentStandards: Input data from different file formats, e.g., text files, csv, rtf, tables
Editing: Paste special, find and replace (extend to more options)
Templates: Agenda, memo, basic resume, CV

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Reinforce content from Grade 10, absolute cell referencing, auto fill options, spreadsheet functions (SUMIF, POWER, RAND, SMALL, LARGE), rounding off numbers (difference between rounding and formatting), conditional formatting, interpreting error indicators (circular reference, #NULL!).

assessmentStandards: Reinforce content, concepts and skills from Grade 10
Using spreadsheet functions such as: Sumif, Power, Rand, Small, Large
Rounding off numbers and the difference between rounding and formatting
Interpreting error indicators such as: Circular reference, #NULL!

nodes.title: Solution Development: Database
nodes.description: First looks (objects: table, form, query, report), tables (records and fields, field names), basic field properties (size, length, default value, decimal places, required), data types, database structure, work with different views (design and table view).

assessmentStandards: First looks: Objects - Table, form, query, report
Tables: Records and fields, field names
Basic field properties: Size, length, default value, decimal places, required
Work with different views, e.g., design and table view

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 11 Term 2 covering Solution Development (Spreadsheets, Database, Word Processing, HTML), Network Technologies, Internet Technologies, Social Implications, Information Management and PAT.

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Reinforce content from Grade 10, spreadsheet functions (COUNTIF, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK, SUMIF), formatting and editing, sorting, basic data validation techniques, use filters, simple IF function, relational operators in IF functions, charts and graphs (create, format, edit), integration techniques.

assessmentStandards: Reinforce content, concepts, and skills from Grade 10
Spreadsheet functions such as: Countif, Counta, Countblank, Sumif
Simple IF function, use of relational operators (> < <= >= <>) in simple IF functions
Charts, graphs: Create, format and edit, meaningful titles and labels, gridlines, legends
Options appropriate to the graph type chosen

nodes.title: Solution Development: Database
nodes.description: Work with different views (design and table view), design database tables with appropriate data types, reinforce and extend field properties, basic queries (using and, or, not, sorting options), selecting which fields to display in a query.

assessmentStandards: Work with different views, e.g., design and table view
Design database tables, choosing appropriate data types
Reinforce and extend the use of field properties
Queries: Design basic queries using and, or, not and sorting options
Selecting which fields to display in a query

nodes.title: Network Technologies: Networks
nodes.description: Local area networks (LAN and WLAN), basic components of a network, connection (wired vs wireless), intranet definition and uses, basic network security.

assessmentStandards: Local area networks (LAN and WLAN), basic components of a network

nodes.title: Internet Technologies: Internet and WWW
nodes.description: Usability of web pages and websites, explore and evaluate web pages and websites, Internet of Things (IoT).

assessmentStandards: Explore web pages, websites and evaluate aspects

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Unauthorised access, ethical use of networks, network safety and security issues, privacy issues, BYOD, big data, crypto currency vs normal currency, blockchain.

assessmentStandards: Unauthorised access, ethical use of networks

nodes.title: Information Management
nodes.description: Task definition, data and information gathering, quality control of information, evaluate questions, evaluate information, evaluate websites.

assessmentStandards: Task definition, data and information gathering

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: Styles (quick style gallery, style set, change and edit a style, create a new style).

nodes.title: Solution Development: HTML and Web Design
nodes.description: Reinforce concepts of websites, web pages, hyperlinks and URLs, HTML syntax, basic HTML tags (opening and closing tags), HTML comments, structure and design of a simple HTML page.

assessmentStandards: Reinforce the concepts of websites, web pages, hyperlinks and URLs, HTML syntax
Basic HTML tags: Opening tag and closing tag
HTML comments, structure and design of a simple HTML page

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 11 Term 3 covering Systems Technologies (software, hardware, computer management), Internet Technologies, Social Implications, Solution Development (Database, Spreadsheets, Word Processing, HTML/Web Design) and Information Management (PAT).

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Software
nodes.description: Role of application software, compatibility issues, updating software, online and web applications, software for users with disabilities, web applications, authentication.

nodes.title: Internet Technologies: Internet, WWW and Communications
nodes.description: Types of digital communications, overview of online services, portable and mobile internet, cellular data service, browser and e-mail software, website accessibility, LTE, 802.11 A,B,G,N, 4IR, 5IR.

assessmentStandards: Overview of portable and mobile internet, cellular data service - cell phone as a modem

nodes.title: Systems Technologies: Hardware, Software and Computer Management
nodes.description: Basic system requirements and link with software, software installation, portable storage medium, internet download, management of files.

assessmentStandards: Basic system requirements: How does it link with software?

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Effects of computer and human error, data types, verification and validation of data, software bugs, hardware failure, how ICTs impact on the workplace and employment practices, introduction to E-learning and M-learning.

assessmentStandards: Effects of computer and human error
How ICTs impact on the workplace and employment practices

nodes.title: Solution Development: Database
nodes.description: Reports (basic calculations at end of report, page headers and footers, report headers and footers), import and export data.

assessmentStandards: Reports: Basic calculations at end of report

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Import and export data, work with sheets, use different print options, integration techniques within package.

nodes.title: Solution Development: Word Processing
nodes.description: Mail merge, reference, table of content, footnotes, captions, citations and bibliography.

nodes.title: Solution Development: HTML and Web Design
nodes.description: Good website and page design considering use of colour, HTML links (attributes: target and name), HTML images (attributes: source and alternate text), HTML lists.

assessmentStandards: Good website, page design - consider use of colour
HTML links, attributes: Target and name
HTML images, attributes: Source and alternate text

nodes.title: Information Management and PAT
nodes.description: Role of spreadsheet and database to process and manipulate data to provide information. Finalise PAT Phase 1, PAT Phase 2 and PAT Phase 3.

assessmentStandards: Role of spreadsheet and database to process and manipulate data to provide information

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Computer Applications Technology Grade 11 Term 4 covering Internet Technologies (Communications), Social Implications, Content using Case Studies, Information Management and PAT, Solution Development (Spreadsheets, Word Processing, Database, Documents) and Final Examination.

nodes.title: Internet Technologies: Communications
nodes.description: Managing e-mail (organise using e-mail folders, sort by, flag, prioritise), distribution lists, message rules, register a web-based e-mail address, URL shortener.

assessmentStandards: Managing e-mail: Organise using e-mail folders sort by, flag, prioritise

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Social engineering tricks, information accuracy, data protection, computer misuse, online harassment, malware and security software, e-commerce and e-banking, ransomware, click jacking, screen lock patterns, introduction to AI.

assessmentStandards: Social engineering tricks, information accuracy, data protection, computer misuse, online harassment
Malware and security software, e-commerce and e-banking

nodes.title: Content Using Case Studies
nodes.description: Hardware configuration of a computer, understand computers and their uses, computers as tools to access and communicate information, make better buying decisions, fix ordinary computer problems, use the internet and e-mail.

assessmentStandards: Computers as tools to access and communicate information
Know how to fix ordinary computer problems
Know how to use the internet and e-mail

nodes.title: Information Management and PAT
nodes.description: Reinforce content, concepts and skills in finalising PAT, templates, plan and design own documents, integration with other packages.

assessmentStandards: Reinforce content, concepts and skills in finalising PAT
Templates, plan and design own documents, integration with other packages

nodes.title: Solution Development: Spreadsheets, Word Processing, Database and Documents
nodes.description: Problem solving using spreadsheets; formatting techniques to fields, records, tables, forms, queries, and reports; integration with other packages; design a database table for a specific scenario; problem solving using databases; use integrated software effectively to reproduce and create documents, manipulate graphics and text, customise templates.

assessmentStandards: Formatting: Techniques to fields, records, tables, forms, queries, and reports
Design a database table for a specific scenario
Use integrated software effectively and efficiently to reproduce and create documents
Manipulate graphics and text within documents
Use media, visual literacy, and technology skills to create products that express understanding
